scope: Descriptive census of the pinned heavy-ladder snapshot. Same-game decisions are correlated.

analysis.scope: Decision steps 30–199 inclusive, price per role 30, workforce <10 and cash >=30. A row is a team decision. Outcomes are submitted orders before simultaneous settlement.

definitions.hire: 2–8 total existing workers. Did the team order at least one worker of the specified role when none vs at least two of that role remain? Waiting included.
definitions.replace: Both roles alive, exactly one remaining worker of the given role, team 2–9. Compare an immediately preceding disappearance of existing worker IDs of only that role vs no disappearance. This cannot detect a newborn killed in its first transition. A replacement may be ordered in addition to another type.
definitions.double: 2–8 existing workers, both bases empty, no enemy can reach either in one step. Order at both bases when 60 <= cash < 90 vs cash >=120. Both groups can afford both orders.
definitions.single: Exactly one recruit order, both bases empty. Under threat = at least one visible enemy worker in the cross around the base. Reach does not imply attack. Zero-cargo collector would tie a sole newborn collector if it moves there. For exposed hires, also measure selected hire role and the opposing submitted arrival after the decision (co-arrival is not intent). Loaded teammate side uses current positions; incoming uses actual same team's joint action at that decision (not enemy actions or next-state input).
definitions.comparison: Within-game contrasts use only appearances with opportunities in both conditions. Means/medians across games do not control for progression, opponent response or state distribution. Counts are repeated steps.
